speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To determine the cause, can you tell me your age and when your last menstrual period was? Also, have you experienced any pelvic pain or urinary symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma, with concurrent ovarian pathology given the adnexal mass. Given the patient's age and postmenopausal bleeding, this requires immediate endometrial biopsy and transvaginal ultrasound for staging.
